purpose: Requirements for doc-link references: DLID-based formal references, link checking, path-fix notification, section IDs, change impact candidates, and inconsistency detection.
summary: FR-007 formal references via reference-link definitions whose title holds a content hash and DLID
FR-009 link checking by actually searching the referenced directory, not relying on stored ToC
FR-010 path-fix information notified only when the current path is confirmed; doc-link never edits links
Section 13.1 section IDs (DLID) appended to every heading and issued only by the DLID assignment operation
FR-013 change impact candidates found by reverse lookup when current hash differs from recorded title hash
FR-014 and FR-015 notification of candidates, no stored notification state, repeated until the AI rewrites the hash
FR-016 inconsistency checks: missing or duplicate IDs, broken references, links lacking DLID, inline links
Rewrites of user documents require showing a list to the user and approval; doc-link never rewrites
Only direct references are listed; indirect impact is detected stepwise by repeated detection
tasks: Designing reference notation and DLID handling in titles
Implementing section ID assignment for headings
Handling moved or renamed documents and path mismatches
Detecting and reporting change impact candidates
Writing tests for reference and impact acceptance criteria
Writing guidance that asks the user before rewriting documents
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 参照と変更通知
